constraints.name: IpAccessPolicy_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: IpRule_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: IpAccessPolicy_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "IpAccessPolicy_guard" BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public."IpAccessPolicy" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_ip_access_policy()

triggers.name: IpRule_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "IpRule_guard" BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."IpRule" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_ip_rule()
